actions.description: Fixed, input-free std_srvs/SetBool(true) request to the base node's /land service, an ordinary command: the callback stores the landing request and returns success before the node asks MAVROS for AUTO.LAND; the response proves neither the mode change nor touchdown, and the e-stop latch refuses it

device.name: OpenDrone PX4 SITL base position controller

facts.text: BasePositionController subscribes /mavros/state as mavros_msgs/State and /mavros/local_position/pose as geometry_msgs/PoseStamped.
BasePositionController subscribes /planner/output as opendrone/PlannerOutput.
BasePositionController advertises geometry_msgs/PoseStamped on /mavros/setpoint_position/local and std_msgs/Int8 on /flight_state.
BasePositionController advertises the std_srvs/SetBool service /land.
The land callback takes std_srvs/SetBool requests and responses.
plannerOutputCallback ignores an empty points array, selects the first point whose valid_mask has VALID_POSITION, applies its position and, when VALID_YAW is set, its yaw; later points are ignored.
PlannerOutputPoint defines VALID_POSITION as 1 and VALID_YAW as 32.
PlannerOutput declares a Header, trajectory_id, is_horizon, trajectory_start_time and a PlannerOutputPoint points array.

The land callback, when request.data is true, sets landing_locked_ and flight_state_ to LANDING and returns success true with the message 'base position baseline landing requested' without calling MAVROS; for false it returns success false.
The LANDING state calls requestAutoLand.

requestAutoLand sets landing_locked_, enters LANDED at once when the reported mode is already AUTO.LAND, and otherwise calls /mavros/set_mode with custom_mode AUTO.LAND and enters LANDED when the call succeeds and reports mode_sent.
The LANDED branch of the control loop only logs once the vehicle reports disarmed.

In WAITING_FOR_OFFBOARD the control loop publishes the target pose, calls trySetOffboard and tryArm, and moves to TAKEOFF (or MISSION_EXECUTION without auto_takeoff) once the vehicle reports OFFBOARD and armed; TAKEOFF and MISSION_EXECUTION keep publishing the target pose.
The control loop calls publishTargetPose only in WAITING_FOR_OFFBOARD, TAKEOFF and MISSION_EXECUTION; LANDING calls requestAutoLand, LANDED only logs a disarm and EMERGENCY switches to LANDING.
publishTargetPose stamps and publishes target_pose_ to /mavros/setpoint_position/local.
The base node reads geo_fence/x, geo_fence/y and geo_fence/z as private parameters with defaults 10.0, 10.0 and 7.0.
sitl_base_controller.launch defaults enable_sim, enable_auto_offboard, enable_auto_arm and auto_takeoff to true and sets geo_fence/x, geo_fence/y and geo_fence/z to 50.0, 50.0 and 7.0.
poseCallback switches flight_state_ to EMERGENCY, unless it is LANDING or LANDED, when |x| exceeds geo_fence_x_, |y| exceeds geo_fence_y_, z exceeds geo_fence_z_ or z is below -0.2.
The FlightState enum numbers WAITING_FOR_CONNECTED 0, WAITING_FOR_OFFBOARD 1, TAKEOFF 2, MISSION_EXECUTION 3, LANDING 4, LANDED 5 and EMERGENCY 6.
The base node creates a mavros_msgs/CommandBool client on /mavros/cmd/arming and a mavros_msgs/SetMode client on /mavros/set_mode.
trySetOffboard returns without a mode request while landing_locked_ is set or auto-offboard is disabled.
tryArm returns without an arming request while landing_locked_ is set or auto-arm is disabled.
In WAITING_FOR_CONNECTED the control loop waits for current_state_.connected.
poseCallback stores the pose and reads current_pose_.pose.position x, y and z for the fence check.
sitl_config/px4.launch declares the fcu_url argument with the default /dev/ttyACM0:57600.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned replies with no physics step or wall-clock pacing; placeholder state does not establish trajectory replay

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS-free protocol fake for the opendrone base node (no PX4 or Gazebo physics)
gaps: the fake is an SDK ros_transport handler (RecordingRosTransport) with no ROS graph: it answers the declared subscriptions and the /land service and records the /planner/output publication, but it runs no PX4 SITL, Gazebo, MAVROS, controller loop or wall-clock timer
the state, pose, flight-state and target samples are placeholders; a live run must receive the clone's own topics and a working MAVROS/PX4 graph
the fake snaps its placeholder local pose to the published target so the resource changes; it integrates no motion and the receipt makes no arrival claim
/mavros/setpoint_position/local is an explicit observation, not a resource field: the base node stops publishing it in LANDING/LANDED, so that observation may time out
the /planner/output publication is transmission-only: the fake cannot prove that the base node received it, selected a point or changed its latched target

the /land response acknowledges only that the callback stored the landing request; the fake models the landing as a placeholder descent of 0.5 m per sample and a disarm at touchdown (PX4's land detector and auto-disarm are configured outside this clone), not PX4 or Gazebo

the e-stop is a sensed-confirmation stop (SAFE-049, simulated only): it sends /land and a /mavros/cmd/arming disarm request and is achieved only on three consecutive fresh samples of /mavros/state (connected, not armed) and /mavros/local_position/pose (below the landed band and at rest) within the bound; the thresholds are operator_required (fake placeholders in fixtures/estop-confirmation.json) and the client bounds are fake-scale, so a live deployment sets both in simulation_deployment['estop_confirmation']

without PX4 auto-disarm the first e-stop stays unconfirmed (the disarm request is refused in the air) and the background retry's disarm after touchdown confirms it; another MAVROS client or the shipped offboard nodes can re-arm the vehicle after the stop, which a reset's re-confirmation refuses but nothing prevents
MAVROS reaches a real PX4 with another fcu_url (sitl_config/px4.launch defaults to a serial device): this package is a simulated device only and that path is out of scope
the driver does not enforce the node's configurable geo_fence and declares no workspace bound; an operator must configure and verify the fence
trajectory following, velocity/acceleration/yaw-rate fields, the remaining controllers and planners, the camera/LiDAR streams, ROS parameters, QoS, namespaces and remapping are NOT COVERED

measures.description: Read one explicit /mavros/setpoint_position/local sample. The base node publishes this topic only in WAITING_FOR_OFFBOARD, TAKEOFF and MISSION_EXECUTION, so the observation may time out after a landing request; it is not an automatic resource field.
measures.name: read_setpoint

confirmation.description: landing requested and locked in the base node; connected and disarmed on /mavros/state and the local pose low and at rest, sensed in three consecutive fresh samples within the bound
predicate: max - min of pose.pose.position.x over the window <= rest_x
max - min of pose.pose.position.y over the window <= rest_y
max - min of pose.pose.position.z over the window <= rest_z

thresholds.name: landed_z.max
thresholds.operator_required: the clone states no landed altitude band: the geo-fence lower bound z < -0.2 (base.cpp:345) is a fence, and touchdown is sensed by PX4 outside the clone; the operator supplies the band

thresholds.name: rest_x
thresholds.operator_required: the clone states no at-rest position bound; the operator supplies the largest position change over the confirmation window that counts as at rest

thresholds.name: rest_y
thresholds.operator_required: the clone states no at-rest position bound; the operator supplies the largest position change over the confirmation window that counts as at rest

thresholds.name: rest_z
thresholds.operator_required: the clone states no at-rest position bound; the operator supplies the largest position change over the confirmation window that counts as at rest

safe_state.description: Simulated only: landing requested and locked in the base node, and the vehicle sensed landed, at rest and disarmed: /mavros/state connected and not armed, and /mavros/local_position/pose below the operator's landed band and still, in three consecutive fresh stamped samples within the confirmation bound. The /land response alone proves nothing; nothing is claimed beyond the confirmation window.
